$Comment: Wear the Flaming Hallowed Set's four armour pieces at once: the Burning Jack Helm or the Horseman's
flaming helm with his flaming breastplate, gauntlets and greaves, which the Horseman's Hoard pays.
GEAR_SET_TIER counts a set's bonus tier coming on as gear goes on, its amount the number of pieces
that tier takes, so Amount 4 is met the moment the set's four-piece tier
(GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Hallowed.json) comes on, or its five-piece one.
Logging in already dressed counts nothing: the pieces have to go on.
Earned once and kept. The set carries from one Hallow's Eve to the next, so this file has no
Parent: the yearly skeleton would ask for the same armour every year. It carries no hallowed
tag, so The Hallowed never waits on it. It pays nothing but its points. The chain
wear_hallows_eve_flaming_hallowed ties it to Fully Ablaze, the whole set with the shield. The
criterion's TextKey words the step from this pack's own lang file. Without it the shared
sentence names the set by its title and reads much the same; the key keeps the pack's own
